lead.headline: 16 of 38 Supreme Court cases from the 5th Circuit in 2021-24 were federal-government appeals; in 2015-20, 1 of 26
lead.number: 16 of 38 (17 counting the consumer finance bureau, CFPB); the other 11 regional circuits stayed at about 12% in both periods; Supreme Court cases per 1,000 5th Circuit appeals rose from 0.57 to 1.50
lead.watch_out: The table this lead is filed under adds nothing; every count comes from the Supreme Court Database and the FJC appeals file.

sources.quote: This week, we highlight cert petitions that ask the court to consider, among other things, whether to reverse a second 5th Circuit ruling that invalidated powers of the agency charged with regulating investments, the Securities and Exchange Commission.

which is scheduled for argument Tuesday at the high court, is one of 13 cases this term out of the US Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit. That’s more than 20% of the Supreme Court’s current workload.
Texas has become a breeding ground for some of the most high-profile, high-stakes legal cases, often brought against the Biden administration by Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton
The 5th Circuit, which hears appeals from Texas, Louisiana and Mississippi, had three rulings upheld by the U.S. Supreme Court, and eight overturned, more than any other court this term.
Once we control for that, its reversal rate was decidedly middling.
The Fifth Circuit was the source of 11 cases decided by the Court—the most of any federal circuit—followed by nine from the Fourth Circuit.
